title: The Road and the Reef
intro: You here for the diving? You picked a bad year. I’m Tom, I fish this bay.

The water got too warm last summer and a lot of the coral went white, and the catch dropped off. It was starting to come back, and then they started cutting the new road up the hill. Now every time it rains the bay turns brown.
The contractor’s foreman said he’d hear me out before they start the next section.
I’m not against the road. I just want them to build it so the bay survives.
